name: depot
title: Depot
description: Manage APT, Flatpak, and local AppImage software on Ubuntu and Debian-based Linux
author: kcnewman

commands.name: install
commands.title: Depot Install
commands.subtitle: APT · Flatpak · Local
commands.description: Search software, install local packages, use bundles, or import a profile

commands.name: manage
commands.title: Depot Manage
commands.subtitle: APT · Flatpak · AppImage
commands.description: Launch, inspect, remove, and export installed software

commands.name: update
commands.title: Depot Update
commands.subtitle: APT · Flatpak
commands.description: Review and install available software updates

commands.name: clean
commands.title: Depot Clean
commands.subtitle: APT · Flatpak
commands.description: Review and remove unused packages, runtimes, and obsolete package archives

preferences.name: aptEnabled
preferences.title: Package Sources
preferences.description: Search and manage software from configured APT repositories
preferences.label: Enable APT

preferences.name: flatpakEnabled
preferences.description: Search and manage applications from configured Flatpak remotes when Flatpak is installed
preferences.label: Enable Flatpak

preferences.name: flatpakScope
preferences.title: Preferred Flatpak Scope
preferences.description: Scope used for local Flatpak files, and preferred when an application is available in both scopes

preferences.name: preferredSource
preferences.title: Preferred Source
preferences.description: Rank this source first when equivalent APT and Flatpak results are available; alternatives remain visible
